test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate direct form of the given sentence.**

His mother told him to phone his father at once.

options.text: His mother said to him, “Phone your father at once.”
His mother said to him, “He has to phone your father at once.”
His mother said to him, “You should phone his father at once.
His mother said to him, “He must phone his father at once.”

solution:
The indirect speech of the given sentence is__** 'His mother said to him, “Phone your father at once.”**__
